headline: Tunisia's Tunindex Gains 1.16% in Weekly Trading on Light Volume
summary: Tunisia's Tunindex rose 1.16% on the week to close at 18,622.76 points on October 30, with trading turnover of roughly $11 million.
why: The Tunindex tracks the performance of publicly traded companies on the Tunis Stock Exchange, reflecting domestic capital market activity and investor sentiment.

impacts.name: Tunindex
impacts.why: The benchmark equity index rose 1.16% over the week on turnover of approximately $11 million.
